newsitem.title: USA: Clarcor to buy United Air Specialists.
newsitem.headline: Clarcor to buy United Air Specialists.

text.p: Clarcor Inc said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire United Air Specialists Inc in an exchange of common stock.
As a result of the acquisition, United Air Specialists will become a subsidiary of Clarcor.

The boards of directors of each company unanimously approved the transaction, which will be structured as a merger. Each fully diluted share of United Air Specialists will be converted into 0.36986 shares of common stock of Clarcor.

The exchange ratio is subject to adjustment based on the actual number of fully diluted United Air shares at closing. United Air Specialists currently has approximately 3,270,000 fully diluted shares outstanding.

Clarcor, which now has about 14,880,000 shares outstanding, will issue about 1,210,000 shares of its common stock to complete the merger. This will bring its total outstanding shares to about 16,090,000.
To cover the costs of the merger, Clarcor said it expects to take a one-time charge to earnings in an amount yet to be determined in the quarter the merger is completed.

Clarcor had sales of approximately $290 million and net earnings of $22.0 million for the fiscal year ended November 30, 1995. Clarcor said it expects fiscal 1996 sales to be approximately $330 million, excluding the United Air acquisition.
United Air Specialists had sales of approximately $40 million and net earnings of $1.5 million for its fiscal year ended June 30, 1996.
Consummation of the merger is subject, among other things, to approval by the shareholders of United Air Specialists and regulatory approvals.

Clarcor said the merger is intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization to United Air Specialists shareholders and be accounted for as a pooling of interests. The merger is expected to close in early 1997.
The three largest shareholders of United Air Specialists, who collectively own approximately 50 percent, of the outstanding shares, have agreed to vote their shares in favor of the merger.

"The combination of Clarcor and United Air Specialists will significantly strengthen and expand our presence in the fast growing environmental and industrial air filtration industry," Larry Gloyd, Clarcor chairman, said in a statement.

"In addition, we will have opportunities to increase shareholder value through business synergies, such as the potential for filter cartridges manufactured by our Airguard Industries operation to be used in filter housings manufactured by UAS (United Air)," he added.
